title: Just a Resourse Pack
description:
This is the official resourse pack of the map Just Fight, both made by MigDINO!

The map can be only played with the creator by now, but in the future, all the players can play the Just Fight.
body:
This is the official resourse pack of the map Just Fight, both made by me!

The map can be only played with me now, but in the future, all the players can play the Just Fight. The resourse pack is specially made to use in the map Just Fight.
